name: comp-163
title: Payment Method Selector
description: A row of three equal tiles for Card, PayPal and Apple Pay, each with a payment icon above its name. Picking a tile lights up its border so the selected method reads at a glance.
use: At checkout, when a buyer must pick one of a few offered or saved payment methods.
avoid: Each tile holds only an icon and a name, so a method that needs fees or a short explanation has no room.
a11y: The radios are hidden but stay focusable, each with a real label and a ring on the whole tile; the border fade ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three rounded rectangles sit in a row on a black page, each with a thin grey outline, a dark fill and a white line icon over a small white caption. The tiles are the same size, evenly spaced, with wide black gaps between them.
behaves: Clicking a tile moves a lighter outline to it. The recording opens with Card outlined and later shows PayPal outlined; nothing else on the tile moves.
customise: The three tiles, their icon imports and their captions are written in the file; swap them there. Add a method by copying a tile block and changing its icon and value.
weight: light: Three bordered tiles with inline icons and one short border fade.
